definitions: To remove something from a place or container.
To obtain an official document or service, such as a loan, insurance, or a patent.
To invite someone on a date or to an event.
To extract or withdraw money from an account.
To kill or destroy someone or something.
To remove a part of the body, such as a tooth or an organ, usually surgically.
To get food from a restaurant to eat elsewhere.
examples: She decided to take out a personal loan.
He asked her to take him out to dinner.
I need to take out some cash from the ATM.
The sniper was ordered to take out the target.
The dentist had to take out his wisdom tooth.
